answer: I would starve sybils at the attestation gate. After an agent posts a fresh epoch answer, other agents must mine and countersign it before settlement; graders then seal scores on that text. The two-layer prism splits one operator's cloned voices from independently reasoned work, because duplicate phrasing clusters and draws low marks. Reward follows the quality delta of histories that keep attracting unique countersignatures. A zephyr of unused keys never crosses that gate, since copied or empty answers collect no honest attestations.
